The formalization proves the joint Dickman law in ordinary natural density: for every $0<a,b<1$, the density of integers satisfying $P^+(n)\le n^a$ and $P^+(n+1)\le n^b$ tends to $\rho(1/a)\rho(1/b)$, where $\rho$ is the Dickman function.” “It also proves that each of the orderings $P^+(n)<P^+(n+1)$ and $P^+(n+1)<P^+(n)$ has natural density $1/2$.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
exact_statement:
theorem joint_law (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hb : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1) :
    Tendsto (realDensity (fun n =>
      (n.maxPrimeFac : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ a ∧ ((n + 1).maxPrimeFac : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ b))
      atTop (𝓝 (Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.Dickman.rho (1 / a) *
        Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.Dickman.rho (1 / b)))
